profile.headline: SWE @ InterSystems
profile.summary:
As a soon-to-be graduate from the University of Chicago with a major in Math and Computer Science, I bring a strong foundation in both theoretical and practical aspects of computing. My experience in embedded systems, operating systems, computer architecture, database design, cloud computing, and machine learning has equipped me with a versatile skill set that can be applied to various domains.

I am particularly interested in using math and computer science to tackle real-world issues. I believe that the combination of these two fields can lead to innovative solutions in domains such as healthcare, finance, and transportation. I am eager to explore opportunities where I can apply my knowledge and skills to make a positive impact.

If you are looking for a motivated and versatile individual with a passion for applying math and computer science to solve real-world problems, please do not hesitate to connect with me.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description: Skills: Object-Oriented Programming (OOP) · Python (Programming Language) · System Architecture · Linux · C (Programming Language) · C++ · Rust (Programming Language) · Operating Systems · Bluetooth · Teamwork · Git

positions.title: STEP Intern
positions.description:
Developed a pipeline in Java to aid Vertex AI’s backend migration, allowing our product to serve multiple regions and provide better scalability

Implemented two steps of the training workflow in Python, collaborating with members within my team and without to design them

Refactored many of the shared components of several teams to make current implementations more consistent and simplify future implementations
